reason: I forget pills at home and travel a lot, so a counted sachet I can toss in my gym bag beats a big bottle. The lab report on the box and the $24.99 launch price make one box an easy try after lifting.
objection: It's still two capsules every single day, and I'll probably skip it after a couple of weeks like every other supplement. Also made in China, so I'd want to actually scan that QR code and see the report matches my batch.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report didn't match the batch number, or the price went above about $35 a box, I'd pass.
